title: Warm Italian Wrap
description: A flavorful Italian-inspired wrap filled with warm, wilted greens and herbs. Perfect for a quick snack or light meal.

ingredients.name: Wilted greens
ingredients.notes: Use a mix of spinach, kale, and arugula

ingredients.name: Herbal mix
ingredients.notes: Combine chopped rosemary, thyme, and oregano

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Slice the Portuguese bread in half lengthwise.
Grill the bread until lightly toasted, about 2-3 minutes per side.
In a small bowl, mix together the wilted greens, herbal mix, mozzarella cheese, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Spread the green mixture onto the bottom half of the bread.
Drizzle with olive oil and top with the top half of the bread.
Grill the wrap for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the cheese is melted and the bread is crispy.
Garnish with chopped fresh basil and serve immediately.
